STATE OF MAINE 

Docket No. 2026-00159 
PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION 

July 9, 2026 

VERSANT POWER 

PROCEDURAL ORDER 
Request for Approval of Terms 

(Scheduling) 
and Conditions (Section 5-F) 

A technical conference was held on July 7, 2026. Versant Power (Versant) 
indicated that it intends to file additional revisions to its proposed Terms and Conditions 
(T&Cs) based on comments made by the Office of the Public Advocate (OPA) and 
Commission Staff. Versant should file proposed revisions by Wednesday, July 22, 
2026. 

Dated at Hallowell, Maine this 9th day of July, 2026. 

/s/ Leslie Raber 
/s/ Richard Hevey 

Presiding Officers
case_title: REQUEST FOR APPROVAL OF TARIFF REVISION SECTION 5 PERTAINING TO VERSANT POWER.
